I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0447233.
The ticket was opened by you for charger
QbdO93,
for charger being stuck on "Select charging point".
I checked the charger yesterday and today, and it seems that the charger is fully functioning, performing also charging sessions:
Unfortunately, I cannot open a SSH connection due to missing credentials, hence I could not counterproof from remote frontend that the HMI is working properly, and that the HMI is not stuck is outlet selection. From the activity of the charger, however, I would exclude it anyway.
Was any action done from your side, that might have solved the issue already before my analysis?
